q: What do I need to join?
a: A smartphone, an email address and proof that you are 16 or older.
Joining and posting are free. We keep a flat 20% of the payout when a side hustle is completed.
All payouts go through the system. EcoCash is the main method supported. Add your EcoCash number in your dashboard profile.

q: What proof of age is accepted?
a: [EDIT HERE: for example a national ID, birth certificate or school ID.] The photo is only used to check your age.

q: Can I do both, find work and post work?
a: Yes. Choose 'Both' when you sign up.
We check every proof of age by hand before you can post or apply. You can still browse while you wait.
